about.title: With heart and passion
about.text1: Hello, I'm Bernhard – teacher, father of three children and Thermomix® consultant from Vienna.
about.text2: I came to the Thermomix® when I was on parental leave with my first son. I wanted to cook healthy for my family, but often had little time and energy in everyday life. The Thermomix® relieved me enormously – less stress, more time for the family and still good, fresh food.
about.text3: Over time, I realized how much you can develop with the Thermomix®: new recipes, more variety and joy in cooking again. I want to pass on exactly this experience and accompany you personally in integrating the Thermomix® into your everyday life and becoming more confident with it step by step.
about.text4: It's important to me that cooking doesn't burden you, but makes your everyday life easier and brings joy again.

step3.details: You'll see how versatile and easy cooking can be and get a real feel for the device in your kitchen.

step6.details: I show you the most important functions, give you tips for the first recipes and help you feel confident with the device quickly. This way cooking is fun from the start.

afterPurchase.outro: From the first conversation until long after the purchase, I'm happy to be there for you.

tm7.title: Technology, Functions & Possibilities
tm7.subtitle: The smart all-in-one kitchen helper for modern kitchens
tm7.intro: On this page, I show you the most important technical features and functions of the Thermomix® TM7, so you can get a clearer picture of what this device can really do in everyday life.

devices.title: One device – replaces many kitchen appliances
devices.subtitle: The TM7 combines many devices in one single system. In practice, this means less space needed, less washing up and much simpler processes in the kitchen.
devices.highlight: Everything you need – in one single device
devices.outro: Many of my customers were surprised how many devices they no longer need after a short time.

modi.title: Functions and Devices
modi.subtitle: The TM7 offers a variety of integrated cooking and working modes:
modi.outro: These modes can be used manually or controlled automatically via guided recipes. It's precisely this combination of technology and guidance that makes the Thermomix® attractive to so many.

cookidoo.title: Guided Cooking with Cookidoo®
cookidoo.subtitle: The TM7 is connected to the official Thermomix® platform Cookidoo®.
features: Thousands of recipes from international cuisine directly on the device
Direct notifications about cooking success on your phone
Automatic settings for time, temperature and speed
cookidoo.outro: Many users especially appreciate that they no longer have to think about how a dish works. The Thermomix® guides them safely through the entire cooking process.

display.title: Display & Operation
display.subtitle: The Thermomix® TM7 is operated via a large touch display.
features: Manual settings possible at any time (font size, …)
Direct access to recipes – even without phone
display.outro: Even people who are not particularly tech-savvy usually find their way around very quickly and appreciate the added value of this display revolution.

accessories.title: Expand your TM7 with the right accessories
accessories.subtitle: With the right accessories, your TM7 becomes even more versatile.
accessories.intro: Whether precise cooking, faster preparation or clever steaming – these compatible extensions get even more out of your cooking experience.

sensor.title: The Thermomix® Sensor (TM7 / TM6)
sensor.intro: Never too dry, never too raw again:
sensor.description: The sensor measures the core temperature of your food and ensures that meat, fish or bread reach exactly the perfect doneness.
sensor.outro: You decide how you want your dish – the TM7 takes care of the rest.

peeler.title: Blade Cover with Peeler
peeler.description: The blade cover with peeler is a real multitasker for your TM7.
peeler.intro: It protects the mixing blade and gives you two major advantages:
peeler.peelText: Potatoes, carrots or beetroot are evenly peeled in the mixing bowl, completely hands-free.
peeler.cookText: The cover protects the mixing blade, so delicate ingredients like sausages, dumplings, gnocchi or vegetables are cooked, not chopped.
idealList: Want more options in the mixing bowl
benefits: No contact of ingredients with the blade
More flexibility for stews, sides & meal prep

gemuesestyler.title: The TM7 Vegetable Styler
gemuesestyler.description: With the Vegetable Styler, your TM7 becomes a real prep helper in the kitchen.
gemuesestyler.intro: Whether slices, strips or grated – your vegetables are evenly cut in seconds and ready for further processing.
gemuesestyler.text: Perfect for anyone who wants to cook fresh but has no time (or desire) for lengthy chopping.
benefits: Direct further processing in the TM7
gemuesestyler.outro: Create fresh, varied dishes in no time and save yourself the space full of cutting boards.

spatel.title: The Thermomix® Spatula
spatel.description: The ergonomically designed spatula is perfectly matched to the mixing bowl. It helps you get every last bit of dough and mixtures out and stir while cooking.
benefits: Perfectly matched to the mixing bowl
Complete emptying of the mixing bowl

schmetterling.title: The Butterfly Whisk
schmetterling.description: The butterfly whisk transforms your TM7 into a whisk attachment. Perfect for cream, egg whites, custards and fluffy batters – everything becomes wonderfully airy.
benefits: Ideal for creams, mousse and desserts

varoma.title: The Varoma® Steamer
varoma.description: With the Varoma® you gently steam vegetables, fish, meat and much more – while a sauce or side dish is prepared in the mixing bowl at the same time. This saves time and preserves vitamins.
benefits: Simultaneous cooking in the mixing bowl

comparison.title: Difference to Classic Food Processors
comparison.subtitle: Compared to conventional food processors, the TM7 offers:
features: Guided recipes instead of manual processes
Many cooking techniques in one system
comparison.outro: The Thermomix® is therefore much more than a classic food processor – it's a complete cooking system.
comparison.imageCaption: Classic food processors can only stir and knead – the TM7 can cook, steam, weigh and much more.

overview.title: 1. Privacy at a Glance
overview.generalText: The following notes provide a simple overview of what happens to your personal data when you visit this website. Personal data is any data with which you can be personally identified. Detailed information on data protection can be found in our privacy policy listed below this text.
overview.responsibleTitle: Who is responsible for data collection on this website?
overview.responsibleText: Data processing on this website is carried out by the website operator. You can find the contact details in the section 'Notice on the Responsible Party' in this privacy policy.
overview.howCollectTitle: How do we collect your data?
overview.howCollectText1: Your data is collected when you provide it to us. This may be data that you enter in a contact form, for example.
overview.howCollectText2: Other data is collected automatically or with your consent when you visit the website by our IT systems. This is mainly technical data (e.g. internet browser, operating system or time of page access). This data is collected automatically as soon as you enter this website.
overview.useDataTitle: What do we use your data for?
overview.useDataText: Part of the data is collected to ensure error-free provision of the website. Other data may be used to analyze your user behavior.
overview.rightsTitle: What rights do you have regarding your data?
overview.rightsText: You have the right at any time to receive free information about the origin, recipient and purpose of your stored personal data. You also have the right to request correction or deletion of this data. If you have given consent to data processing, you can revoke this consent at any time for the future. You also have the right to request restriction of processing of your personal data under certain circumstances. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority.

general.title: 2. General Information and Mandatory Information
general.privacyText1: The operators of these pages take the protection of your personal data very seriously. We treat your personal data confidentially and in accordance with the statutory data protection regulations and this privacy policy.
general.privacyText2: When you use this website, various personal data is collected. Personal data is data with which you can be personally identified. This privacy policy explains what data we collect and what we use it for. It also explains how and for what purpose this is done.
general.privacyText3: We point out that data transmission over the Internet (e.g. when communicating by email) may have security gaps. Complete protection of data against access by third parties is not possible.
general.responsibleIntro: The responsible party for data processing on this website is:
general.responsibleExplanation: The responsible party is the natural or legal person who alone or jointly with others decides on the purposes and means of processing personal data (e.g. names, email addresses, etc.).
general.storageDurationText: Unless a more specific storage period has been mentioned within this privacy policy, your personal data will remain with us until the purpose for data processing no longer applies. If you assert a legitimate request for deletion or revoke consent to data processing, your data will be deleted unless we have other legally permissible reasons for storing your personal data (e.g. tax or commercial law retention periods); in the latter case, deletion will take place after these reasons cease to apply.
general.legalBasisTitle: General Information on the Legal Bases of Data Processing on this Website
general.legalBasisText: If you have consented to data processing, we process your personal data on the basis of Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR or Art. 9 para. 2 lit. a GDPR if special categories of data are processed according to Art. 9 para. 1 GDPR. If your data is required for contract fulfillment or for pre-contractual measures, we process your data on the basis of Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR. Furthermore, we process your data if this is necessary to fulfill a legal obligation on the basis of Art. 6 para. 1 lit. c GDPR. Data processing may also be based on our legitimate interest according to Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR.
general.revokeTitle: Revocation of Your Consent to Data Processing
general.revokeText: Many data processing operations are only possible with your express consent. You can revoke consent already given at any time. The legality of data processing carried out until revocation remains unaffected by the revocation.
general.objectionTitle: Right to Object to Data Collection in Special Cases and Direct Advertising (Art. 21 GDPR)
general.objectionText1: If data processing is based on Art. 6 para. 1 lit. E or F GDPR, you have the right at any time to object to the processing of your personal data for reasons arising from your particular situation; this also applies to profiling based on these provisions.
general.objectionText2: If your personal data is processed for direct marketing purposes, you have the right to object at any time to processing of personal data concerning you for such marketing; this also applies to profiling insofar as it is related to such direct marketing.
general.complaintTitle: Right to Lodge a Complaint with the Competent Supervisory Authority
general.complaintText: In the event of violations of the GDPR, data subjects have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority, in particular in the Member State of their habitual residence, place of work or place of the alleged violation. The right to lodge a complaint exists without prejudice to other administrative or judicial remedies.
general.portabilityText: You have the right to have data that we process automatically on the basis of your consent or in fulfillment of a contract handed over to you or to a third party in a common, machine-readable format. If you request direct transfer of data to another controller, this will only be done to the extent technically feasible.
general.infoText: Within the framework of the applicable legal provisions, you have the right at any time to free information about your stored personal data, its origin and recipients and the purpose of data processing and, if applicable, a right to correction or deletion of this data. For this purpose and for further questions on the subject of personal data, you can contact us at any time.
general.restrictionText: You have the right to request restriction of processing of your personal data. You can contact us at any time for this purpose. The right to restriction of processing exists in the following cases:
general.restrictionItem1: If you dispute the accuracy of your personal data stored by us, we usually need time to verify this. For the duration of the verification, you have the right to request restriction of processing of your personal data.
general.restrictionItem2: If the processing of your personal data was/is unlawful, you can request restriction of data processing instead of deletion.
general.restrictionItem3: If we no longer need your personal data, but you need it to exercise, defend or assert legal claims, you have the right to request restriction of processing of your personal data instead of deletion.
general.restrictionItem4: If you have lodged an objection pursuant to Art. 21 para. 1 GDPR, a balance must be struck between your interests and ours. As long as it has not yet been determined whose interests prevail, you have the right to request restriction of processing of your personal data.
general.restrictionOutro: If you have restricted the processing of your personal data, this data may - apart from being stored - only be processed with your consent or for the assertion, exercise or defense of legal claims or for the protection of the rights of another natural or legal person or for reasons of important public interest of the European Union or a Member State.
general.sslText1: For security reasons and to protect the transmission of confidential content, such as orders or inquiries that you send to us as the site operator, this site uses SSL or TLS encryption. You can recognize an encrypted connection by the fact that the address line of the browser changes from 'http://' to 'https://' and by the lock symbol in your browser line.
general.sslText2: If SSL or TLS encryption is activated, the data you transmit to us cannot be read by third parties.
general.spamText: The use of contact data published as part of the imprint obligation for sending unsolicited advertising and information materials is hereby objected to. The operators of the pages expressly reserve the right to take legal action in the event of unsolicited sending of advertising information, such as spam emails.

dataCollection.title: 3. Data Collection on this Website
dataCollection.cookiesText1: Our websites use so-called 'cookies'. Cookies are small data packets and do not cause any damage to your device. They are either stored temporarily for the duration of a session (session cookies) or permanently (permanent cookies) on your device. Session cookies are automatically deleted after your visit. Permanent cookies remain stored on your device until you delete them yourself or they are automatically deleted by your web browser.
dataCollection.cookiesText2: Cookies have various functions. Many cookies are technically necessary because certain website functions would not work without them. Other cookies can be used to analyze user behavior or for advertising purposes.
dataCollection.cookiesText3: Cookies that are required to carry out the electronic communication process or to provide certain functions you have requested (necessary cookies) are stored on the basis of Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR. The website operator has a legitimate interest in storing necessary cookies for the technically error-free and optimized provision of its services.
dataCollection.cookiesText4: You can set your browser to inform you about the setting of cookies and only allow cookies in individual cases, exclude the acceptance of cookies for certain cases or in general, and activate automatic deletion of cookies when closing the browser. If cookies are deactivated, the functionality of this website may be limited.
dataCollection.contactFormText1: If you send us inquiries via the contact form, your details from the inquiry form, including the contact details you provided there, will be stored by us for the purpose of processing the inquiry and in case of follow-up questions. We do not pass on this data without your consent.
dataCollection.contactFormText2: This data is processed on the basis of Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR if your inquiry is related to the fulfillment of a contract or is necessary for the implementation of pre-contractual measures. In all other cases, processing is based on our legitimate interest in effective processing of inquiries addressed to us (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR) or on your consent (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR) if this was requested.
dataCollection.contactFormText3: The data you enter in the contact form will remain with us until you request deletion, revoke your consent to storage, or the purpose for data storage no longer applies. Mandatory statutory provisions - in particular retention periods - remain unaffected.
dataCollection.emailTitle: Inquiry by Email, Phone or Fax
dataCollection.emailText1: If you contact us by email, phone or fax, your inquiry including all resulting personal data (name, inquiry) will be stored and processed by us for the purpose of processing your request. We do not pass on this data without your consent.
dataCollection.emailText2: This data is processed on the basis of Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR if your inquiry is related to the fulfillment of a contract or is necessary for the implementation of pre-contractual measures. In all other cases, processing is based on our legitimate interest in effective processing of inquiries addressed to us (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR) or on your consent (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR) if this was requested.
dataCollection.emailText3: The data you send to us via contact requests will remain with us until you request deletion, revoke your consent to storage, or the purpose for data storage no longer applies. Mandatory statutory provisions - in particular statutory retention periods - remain unaffected.
dataCollection.whatsappText1: For communication with our customers and other third parties, we use the instant messaging service WhatsApp, among others. The provider is WhatsApp Ireland Limited, 4 Grand Canal Square, Grand Canal Harbour, Dublin 2, Ireland.
dataCollection.whatsappText2: Communication takes place via end-to-end encryption (peer-to-peer), which prevents WhatsApp or other third parties from accessing the communication content. dataCollection.whatsappText3: The use of WhatsApp is based on our legitimate interest in the fastest and most effective communication possible with customers, interested parties and other business and contractual partners (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR). dataCollection.whatsappText4: The communication content exchanged between us on WhatsApp will remain with us until you request deletion, revoke your consent to storage, or the purpose for data storage no longer applies. dataCollection.whatsappText5: The company has a certification under the 'EU-US Data Privacy Framework' (DPF). The DPF is an agreement between the European Union and the USA that is intended to ensure compliance with European data protection standards for data processing in the USA.
